{{Quote|Your name is Varian Skye. You were born in Tahini and moved to Courscant with your brother when you were 12. Your brother, Patrio, soon returned home, but you'd found an apprenticeship in a dressmaking studio and decided to stay.|Recording giving Cassian Andor his aliases backstory|<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />}}
'''Patrio''' was the fictitious [[gender|brother]] of Varian Skye, an alias used by the [[human]] [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] during a mission to [[Ghorman]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> in [[3 BBY]].<ref name="GhormanDate">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates the events of "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" to [[3 BBY]].</ref> According to the cover story, Patrio and Skye moved to the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] when Skye was twelve [[Standard year|years]] old, but Patrio soon returned home to [[Tahini]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Behind the scenes==
Patrio was mentioned in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," an episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
